research.facts:
LeBron James / 76ers Summer Workouts
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- LeBron James signed 2-year, $7.94M deal with Philadelphia 76ers with 2027-28 player option and 15% trade kicker (ESPN, NBA.com, Philadelphia Inquirer — confirmed)
- Contract signed July 26; officially announced by the Sixers July 27, 2026 (Fox 29 Philadelphia, PhillyVoice)
- LeBron will NOT hold an introductory press conference — has not held one since 2010 Miami Heat signing; first official event will be Media Day in ~8 weeks (Evan Sidery, verified journalist, X/Twitter)
- LeBron is already working out with Tyrese Maxey in Los Angeles (Bleacher Report, July 31)
- 76ers planning August mini camps for the new core (multiple sources)
- Projected starting five: LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
- Jaylen Brown traded from Celtics to 76ers on July 6 for Paul George + two first-round picks + two second-round picks (ESPN confirmed)
- LeBron holds 672 career 30-point games vs. Michael Jordan's 671 — one game separates him from sole ownership (The Source / ClutchPoints, July 31)
- LeBron broke Karl Malone's record for oldest player to record a triple-double in February 2026 (28-12-10 vs Dallas at 41 years, 44 days old)
- A 20-point season in Philadelphia would give him 24 straight 20-point seasons — stands alone
- If 76ers win a title, LeBron would be first player to win championships with 4 different franchises
- New York Knicks are 2026 NBA Champions (beat San Antonio Spurs 4-1; Jalen Brunson won Finals MVP, scored 45 points in Game 5, 94-90 final; first Knicks title since 1973, ending 53-year drought) — multiple confirmed sources including NBA.com
- Opening night 2026-27: October 20, 2026; Knicks host banner-raising ceremony
- LeBron called the 76ers move his "last decision" and said it came after strongly considering retirement (ESPN)
- Recruited by Maxey, Embiid, and Brown's agent Rich Paul; Nick Nurse only coach LeBron spoke with
**MEDIUM confidence:**
- 76ers among Eastern Conference title favorites alongside Knicks

research.facts:
Kawhi Leonard Investigation
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- NBA probe into Clippers/Kawhi could extend into 2027 per ESPN sources (July 29-30)
- Investigation: Clippers allegedly funneled money to Leonard through $28M "no-show" endorsement deal with Aspiration (now-bankrupt company); Clippers owner Steve Ballmer invested $50M in Aspiration
- NBPA will pursue formal arbitration if league seeks punishment without sufficient evidence (Yahoo Sports/ESPN)
- Outside law firm (Wachtell Lipton) finished fact-finding; NBA now reviewing and determining discipline
- Toronto trade terms (ESPN, NBA.com confirmed): Leonard to Toronto for Brandon Ingram + Gradey Dick + unprotected 2031 and 2033 first-round picks + 2030 and 2033 second-round picks + 2027 first-round swap
- Both teams chose to pause trade; NBA did not formally "pause" it (Raptors refusing to accept penalty liability in writing)
- Dillon Brooks told streamer 'Neon' the Kawhi-to-Toronto trade won't happen (HoopsHype, July 31)
- Kawhi's 2026-27 salary: $50.3M
- Potential penalties include: player suspension, contract voiding, $350K+ fines, draft picks
**MEDIUM confidence:**
- Adam Silver "hopeful" to resolve by end of summer — but NBPA arbitration could extend timeline significantly
